newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 24.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian President Henri Konan Bedie preaches regional peace
- Leader of opposition Rally of the Republicans Party, Djeni Kobina, says his party will only enter broad-based government if President Bedie agrees to set up an independent national
- Number of new tuberculosis cases in Ivory Coast has risen by 10 percent, health officials say
- Producers and buyers of tropical produce in Ivory Coast ask government to lower export tax for their sector
